goal: Choose measurable portfolio outcomes and resolve scope, budget and ownership tradeoffs.
acceptance: Each active initiative has one accountable owner and observable success checks.
Allocation totals fit the global ceiling without counting a parent and child allocation as separate spend.
Rejected and deferred options retain their reasons; unverified claims remain labeled.
prompt: Compare the two scoped options. Recommend one within the supplied budget, name the opportunity cost and stop conditions, and return a decision packet. Do not initiate work or invent approval.
